Description: A hand-unrolled complex quadratic iteration that turns Mandelbrot and Julia-set structure into animated spatial displacement.
KScript: var cx := x*v0 + cos(t*v1 + u*v2)*v3; var cy := y*v0 + sin(t*v1 + u*v2)*v3; var zx := x*v4; var zy := y*v4; var nx := zx*zx - zy*zy + cx; var ny := 2.0*zx*zy + cy; zx := nx; zy := ny; nx := zx*zx - zy*zy + cx; ny := 2.0*zx*zy + cy; zx := nx; zy := ny; nx := zx*zx - zy*zy + cx; ny := 2.0*zx*zy + cy; zx := nx; zy := ny; nx := zx*zx - zy*zy + cx; ny := 2.0*zx*zy + cy; zx := nx; zy := ny; var escape := sqrt(zx*zx + zy*zy); var shade := clamp(escape/max(v5, 0.001), 0.0, 1.0); z += shade*v6; sx := sx*(1.0 + (1.0-shade)*v7); sy := sy*(1.0 + (1.0-shade)*v7); sz := sz*(1.0 + (1.0-shade)*v7);
